verdict_reason: Test still proves trailing-slash normalisation with the new org header, but adds a no-op doNothing stub copied from DocumentControllerTest and a mis-indented builder line.

todos.issue: allowTraderNotificationAccess() (lines 53-56) stubs doNothing() on requireTraderAccess, a void method on a @MockitoBean that already does nothing by default. The set-up changes nothing, yet its name claims it grants access, and the same no-op block is copied verbatim in DocumentControllerTest.java:77-80.
todos.fix: Must: neither DocumentController test class carries set-up that has no effect; the mock's default void behaviour is what lets the request through. One way: delete the @BeforeEach method and the now-unused doNothing/anyString/BeforeEach imports here and in DocumentControllerTest.

todos.issue: The added .header(TraderOrganisationHeaderFilter.ORGANISATION_ID_HEADER, "5900002") call is indented 14 spaces while its sibling builder calls (.contentType, .content) sit at 12, so the chain reads as if .header were nested.
todos.fix: Must: every call in the mockMvc.perform(post(...)) builder chain sits at the same indent. One way: drop the line to 12 spaces to match .contentType and .content.
